name: 653. A forwarded body that gives a member twice is refused 400 before any plugin reads it (repeated body member refused)
description: TXE-7994. A body forwarded to the provider as written (a passthrough body, or a raw request body) was read by Bifrost's gates with gjson, which keeps the first of two equal keys, while encoding/json, sonic and the vendor keep the last. A virtual key restricted to model A could send {"model":"A","model":"B"}: governance checked A and the provider ran B. Core now refuses, with 400 caller_invalid_request naming the member's path and before any plugin runs (PluginPipeline.RunLLMPreHooks): a JSON key given twice in one object at any depth (model also when only its case differs), a JSON body that does not parse strictly or nests past 512 levels, and a multipart name given twice when any of its parts is a text field (read by the declared boundary; a multipart body that does not parse is refused). The rows use the native Anthropic Messages passthrough to DeepSeek's Anthropic endpoint on tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs (providerErrorFixture=1, the gateway of provider-error-fixture.config.json, as folder 311). Rows 1 and 2 are red on a gateway without the fix: the body is forwarded and answered 200. Row 3 is the control: the same body naming each member once is still forwarded. Each row finds its own request at the fixture by a metadata.user_id marker, so no fixture reset is needed. Go-level coverage: TestRepeatedBodyModelCannotRunAModelTheKeyIsNotAllowed (plugins/governance), TestRunLLMPreHooksRefusesAmbiguousForwardedBody and TestEveryPluginGateRunsBehindTheForwardedBodyGuard (core), TestAmbiguousBodyMember and TestForwardedBodyCoversEveryRawBodyField (core/schemas).
